Rendering & lighting

Overview

  • Backends: DirectX 12 is the default on Windows, and Vulkan is used everywhere else (through MoltenVK on Apple platforms). Windows builds can also use Vulkan. Web builds use WebGPU.
  • Clustered deferred shading supports large numbers of dynamic lights. Translucent materials use a forward clustered pass.
  • Baked lighting comes from the lightmapper built into the editor, along with reflection and irradiance probes for moving objects.
  • Realtime GI & reflections: In addition to our baked lighting, Glimmer gives you realtime GI on desktop and in the browser, no ray tracing hardware needed. It's on by default. HWRT-supported devices can also use DDGI and ray traced reflections. For non-HWRT we have screen space reflections. Screen space global illumination deprecatation is planned so it is not recommended to use
  • Shaders are written in HLSL, compiled with DXC, and reload live in the editor on save.
